lessons: CORRECTED an error from v1.3.0 (caught when re-checking tool accuracy): self-employed reservists do NOT get 25% INSTEAD of the 40% tosefet, they get the tagmul (incl. 40%) PLUS an additional 25% (verified btl.gov.il: לעובד עצמאי משולם בנוסף לתגמול גם פיצוי בשיעור 25%). Fixed SKILL+HE+gotcha. miluim-daily-pay tool got an employee/self-employed field (was computing employee-only, so self-employed got a wrong, too-low number).

THE 40% SUPPLEMENT IS A REMAINDER RULE, not a flat uplift. BTL divides the service days by 7 and pays the supplement only on the remainder (0 -> nothing, 6 -> +1 full day). 7/14/21 days therefore earn NO supplement at all. The skill (and the live /tools calculator) multiplied every day by 1.4, overstating a 21-day call-up by 40% (11,760 instead of 8,400). The skill's OWN reference file carried the correct worked example (400/day x 21 = 8,400) while the Gotchas section branded that same arithmetic as a ~40% under-estimate. An internal contradiction between a reference file and the body is a free bug detector.

BTL's own examples table has one row (120 -> 122) that contradicts the rule stated three lines above it (120 mod 7 = 1 -> 120.4). The stated rule reproduces 19 of their 20 rows, so the rule was encoded and the outlier row treated as a typo, and that decision is documented in the checker's sources. When a source disagrees with itself, follow the normative rule text, not a single table cell, and say so.

WRONG PAYING AGENCY: Tagmul Nosaf and Tagmul Meyuchad are IDF payments (automatic, by 1 May, to the account registered with the unit; chased at 1111 ext. 4), not Bituach Leumi ones. The skill routed users to the BTL portal and *6050 -- the exact 'wrong agency' failure the skill itself warns about elsewhere.

Tagmul Meyuchad starts at 32 cumulative shamap days, not 60 (the skill said 60 in six places), and its daily rate is BANDED by unit activity tier (133/113/86/60/40/30), not a flat top-band rate. Same banded-amount-quoted-flat disease as the bituach-leumi skill.

FORM 510 IS THE EMPLOYER'S WAGE CONFIRMATION. The reservist's personal claim is 502. The skill's 'employer refuses to pay -> file 510' fallback sent the reservist to a form only that employer can complete. Verified against the BTL reserve-duty forms index: 501 employer claim, 502 personal claim, 509 advance, 510 employer wage confirmation.

The self-employed cap was breached in two different directions at once: the prose clamped before the +40% and the checker clamped after it and then added 25%. BTL: 'סכום התגמול והפיצוי יחד, לא יעלה על התגמול המקסימלי'.

CARRY: the IDF Aka / Keren HaSiyua grant table in references/2026-law-changes.md still does not match the 2026 תקנון (the student tutoring grant is a 3-tier banded amount with a 21-day minimum, and several named grants in the skill do not appear in the regulations under those names). Not fixed this cycle.
CARRY: Amendment 283 credits are granted in the tax year FOLLOWING the service year; SKILL.md still implies same-year credit in Example 4.

RESOLVED CARRY: the IDF grant table was rebuilt against the verbatim 2026 policy. 2026 moved to a six-level מדרג פעילות model and tzav shagra now counts, so every flat pre-2026 amount in the skill was a top-band value. Confirmed directly from a browser render of miluim.idf.il with accordions expanded.

RESOLVED CARRY: Amendment 283 credits are granted in the tax year FOLLOWING the service year. Double-confirmed: statute 39B opens 'בשנת המס שקדמה לה', and kolzchut states 'ששירתו לפחות 30 ימים בשנת 2025 זכאים לנקודות זיכוי במס הכנסה בשנת המס 2026'. Both SKILL.md and SKILL_HE.md now state it explicitly.

CORRECTED A LIVE USER-HARM BUG: תגמול מיוחד was documented as starting at 32 cumulative shamap days. The 2026 policy says 'זכאים לתגמול מיוחד החל מהיום ה-61 כולל'. The skill was telling reservists with 32-59 days they were owed a payment they are not entitled to, and the previous cycle had actively 'corrected' 60 down to 32. Section 8 days from 07.10.2023 to 31.12.2025 do count toward the 60.
The tier count for Amendment 283 was labelled '17 tiers' everywhere while the table itself has 15 rows. Label and table disagreed for at least two cycles; nobody counted the rows.

Grant NAMES were wrong, not just amounts: מענק לילד מוגבל is actually מענק משפחה מיוחדת, מענק השלמה לנופש is actually שובר נופש, קרן שיעורים פרטיים is actually the student tuition/tutoring support. Six grants were missing entirely (commanders, כלכלת הבית מוגדל, הוצאות אישיות, חופשת לידה, קייטנות, סיוע נפשי).
The '6.2 billion NIS' figure appears only in press coverage of the 25.01.2026 government decision, not in the IDF policy page or the תקנון. Removed from all descriptions as an unsourced claim.

Student tuition was documented as '50+ days = up to 100%'. The 50 days are only the gate; the share is banded 100/85/65/30/30/22 by מדרג. The academic-credit-reduction table in the skill does not appear in the 2026 policy at all and was removed.
CARRY: SKILL.md has 27 headings and SKILL_HE.md has 29 (Hebrew carries two extra worked examples). Pre-existing parity divergence, not introduced this cycle.

CARRY: tool_manifests/miluim-daily-pay has a stale sources note stating a flat top-band supplement from day 32. It does NOT reach the formula (the tool computes BTL tagmul only and explicitly excludes the IDF payments), so no user got a wrong number, but the note must be corrected to 'banded 133/113/86/60/40/30 from day 61' when the checker is regenerated.
תגמול נוסף does not appear anywhere in the 2026 IDF policy page. The skill still documents it (10+ days, paid by 1 May). Treat as unverified for 2026 and re-source before the next release.

SKILL.md breached the 5,000-word cap during this rewrite and needed roughly 600 words moved into references/2026-law-changes.md. The full band tables belong in the reference; SKILL.md keeps a compact summary plus the tier warning.

RESOLVED: the 7 legacy PENDING_VERIFICATION evidence entries were worked through. Form 3010 sourced to the kolzchut 3010 page, exemption ages to the kolzchut age-exemption page (which corrected the skill: statutory 40 enlisted / 45 officers, with a 09.08.2024-30.06.2027 temporary order setting per-role ages of 45 or 49, NOT the 41/46/49-50 the skill claimed), Amendment 253 to the Sefer HaChukim PDF, and the BTL figures re-anchored on fragments that actually survive the verifier's normalization.

WRONG DEPARTMENT, found while sourcing: the skill sent disability and PTSD claims to hachvana.mod.gov.il in 7 places. That is האגף לחיילים משוחררים ומילואים (discharge grant, pikadon, scholarships). Agaf HaShikum is shikum.mod.gov.il. This was the skill's own 'wrong agency' failure mode, in the skill itself.

THE BIG PROCESS LESSON: this cycle rewrote SKILL.md and SKILL_HE.md and did NOT propagate to references/, metadata.json, evidence.json, or the Gotchas. Both reviewers caught it independently and it took a second full fix round. Phase 3f.1 exists precisely for this. In future, after ANY figure or rule change, grep the OLD value across the WHOLE folder (both references, metadata.json, evidence.json, scripts, and the Gotchas and Examples sections) and require zero hits before running the panel.

Residual bugs the previous cycle's 'fixed' claim did not actually cover: Form 510 was still given as the self-employed / refused-employee route in 4 places (EN troubleshooting, HE troubleshooting, the filing guide, and 2026-law-changes), and Example 2 told a self-employed reservist to file 510. The form MAP was corrected last cycle; the INSTRUCTIONS that use it were not.

Unsourced claims removed rather than shipped: the MoD disability band-to-payout table (1-9/10-19/20%+), the 6.2 billion package figure, an NIS 1.1 billion cost figure, a VATAT academic-credit-reduction table, and a Hebrew-only claim that commanders are paid beyond 60 days and age-exempt reservists from day one.

CARRY: spouse post-service dismissal protection is stated as a flat 14 days in one record and as scaling with the reservist's own (up to 60) in another. Neither is sourced; every location is now hedged and the length must be resolved against the statute next cycle.
CARRY: תגמול נוסף is absent from the 2026 IDF policy page. Every location now flags the 10-qualifying-day rule as unverified for 2026; re-source it or drop the threshold.

CARRY: 26 of 67 evidence entries still carry restated summaries rather than verbatim quotations, mostly because their source URLs are bot-blocked (gov.il 403, knesset 247) or JS-rendered. They do not mislead a user but they are not real verification; work them down in future cycles.

CARRY: tool_manifests/miluim-daily-pay still has a stale sources note about a flat supplement from day 32. It does not reach the formula (the tool computes BTL tagmul only), so no user got a wrong number, but regenerate the checker to correct it.
